content:
Last month, there were reports that Apple is developing a brand-new, AI-powered shopping assistant for the Apple Store app on iPhone and iPad.

The company now appears to be rolling out this feature to some users in the form of an "Early Preview".

In the Apple Store app, some users will now see a new chat-style icon in the bottom right corner, replacing the traditional search icon. On that page, users can search for products or start a conversation with a "virtual shopping assistant".

The related prompts include the following suggestions:

  • The latest Apple products
  • Check my Trade-in value
  • Explain carrier offers
  • Help me pick an Apple Watch
  • iPhone monthly instalment plan
  • Compare the iPad lineup

The image above is a preview of this new design, provided by ShrimpApplePro on X.

Apple's fine print states:

The shopping assistant in the Apple Store app is not available to everyone. Apple says the feature is currently open to some users in "Early Preview" form, and there is no word yet on when it will roll out fully.

What do you think of Apple adding this brand-new AI assistant to the Apple Store app? Would you use it? Feel free to let us know in the comments below.
